# MASRA Studio

> MASRA is a visual production studio in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, focused on
> the professional execution of photography — from concept to final
> delivery. Since 2023 it has worked with 200+ brands. Work is grouped into
> three categories: Artistic, Lifestyle and Menu photography. Services:
> photography, videography, phone photography, food styling, art direction
> and graphic design.

## Site

- [Home](https://masra.sa/): about, work (by category), services, featured clients and contact
- [Client projects](https://masra.sa/work/peti): one page per client at /work/<id> — peti, idmi, labonte, mamola, shaya, riyadh, maqsoud
- [Start a project via WhatsApp](https://wa.me/966536267188): new project inquiries
- [Instagram](https://instagram.com/wemasra): latest work
